thread:
jamie: Proposal: 'Spark Lab' pilot to test credit-decay (expire credits faster) vs flat starter credits, plus two prompt-template approaches. Goal: +15% week-1 activation and lower cost-per-activation. Thoughts? :seedling:

maya: Love it. Recommend 100 seats, randomize 50/50. Arms: Decay-credits (50 -> 20 after 72h) vs Flat-credits (70 fixed). Templates: Guided (5 hand-curated) vs Open (10 examples). That makes 4 cells but we can prioritize 2 main arms first.

nate: Creative angle: "Get useful output fast" micro-clip + social cards. Landing CTAs: Claim credits / Join office hours. Need hero image and two short GIFs.

leah: Office hours: 3 sessions across regions during week 1. Registration flow: confirm email, calendar add, and an in-app nudge after first success pointing to templates. Follow-up email with replay + reminder that bonus credits expire.

samir: Infra: pre-warm Dedicated pool 25min before each slot. Set cap=16 GPUs and fallback to quantized model at 80% util. Enable prefix caching for starter templates and a warmed KV key script.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Autoscale set for project/spark-lab (min=1,max=16). Alert: p95 latency > 600ms -> page.

jamie: Measurement plan: cohort n=100, tag utm=spark_lab. Primary metric = week1_activation (generation >10 tokens + marked useful). Secondary: CPL, webinar attendance, token cost per activation. Dashboard reqs?

maya: Dashboard: show week1, day1, CPL, A/B cell breakdown, and heatmap of time-to-first-success. I'll mock widgets and share before EOD.

jamie: Action items: @nate assets by Mon EOD, @samir infra pre-warm + fallback, @leah email + reg flow, @maya dashboard + randomization. Quick sync Thu 9:30 to confirm go/no-go. Thanks! :tada:
